newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Probanka 96 net profit jumps 56 pct.
newsitem.headline: Probanka 96 net profit jumps 56 pct.

text.p: Slovenian bank Probanka said on Friday provisional 1996 net profit surged 56 percent to 340 million tolars ($2.17 million), adding it expected to turn in a profit of 500 million tolars in 1997.

"Our profit was boosted by a very good performance and rise in almost all areas of our business, especially by expansion to Ljubljana and increase of cross-border transactions," Janez Senica, deputy chief executive of Probanka, told Reuters.
Balance sheet assets rose to to 22.3 billion tolars in 1996 from 17.9 billion in 1995.
The bank said its market share in 1996 rose to 1.29 percent from 1.25 and added it planned to increase it to about 1.33 percent this year.

Probanka said this year's dividend would most probably be higher than the 1,000 tolars per share paid last year, but said the exact figure had not yet been determined. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
